props.name: timeout
props.description: Milliseconds of inactivity before the session ends.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Milliseconds before the end at which to warn.

props.name: onExtend
props.description: Extend the session. Await it, and the dialog stays until it settles.

props.name: onExpire
props.description: The session has ended. Sign the person out here.

props.name: syncKey
props.description: localStorage key used to share activity between tabs. Empty disables it.

props.name: paused
props.description: Suspend the whole thing — while a payment is being confirmed, say.
